applicableAreas: Sheet 9 (Site Plan) and potentially other sheets
findings.comment: Sheet 9 title block shows SP-2023-0126C per vision analysis, but official documentation states SP-2025-0126C. The site plan number format SP-XXXX-XXXX appears correct where visible, but the year discrepancy between sheets (2023 vs 2025) cannot be verified without examining the actual source document. Landscape sheets 30-31 use project number format (013-25-01) instead of SP-XXXX-XXXX format.

Scale verification completed for plan sheets (1" = 20') and location map (1" = 400'), but utility plan-profile sheets (19-20) and standard details sheets (23-28) were not examined visually to confirm scale legibility and format on all sheets.

Sheet sizes confirmed as 24" × 36" for Sheets 21-22. However, sheet sizes for utility sheets 19-20 and landscape sheets 30-31 (which show inconsistent numbering 27-28 of 35) were not verified. Landscape sheets may be from a separate document set with different sizing standards.

Location map exists on cover sheet with north arrow, but visual clarity and whether site location is sufficiently clear relative to surrounding context could not be fully verified without examining the source document.

applicableAreas: Overall site plan sheets and proposed development sheets
findings.comment: The primary site plan (Sheet 9) does not clearly distinguish existing conditions from proposed development. While Sheet 4 shows existing conditions and Sheet 8 shows demolition, the main Site Plan (Sheet 9) does not use consistent visual treatment (colors, line weights, symbols, labeling, or graying) to distinguish proposed buildings and improvements from any existing conditions that remain or are referenced. Linework and features lack clear visual segregation.

applicableAreas: Drainage area maps and impervious cover exhibits
findings.comment: Sheets 13-14 are listed as drainage area maps, but visual examination of whether base impervious cover, redeveloped impervious cover, and new impervious cover are shown with distinct shading and clear labeling could not be verified from the available text descriptions.

Sheet 4 is labeled 'Existing Conditions Survey' and the guide indicates it shows existing topography and existing conditions. However, visual verification that the sheet reflects current (not proposed) grades and layout, and whether it is clearly distinguished from the demolition plan, requires examination of the actual source document.
